t: This is Chesterfield Street in Mayfair, described as a virtually intact Georgian street. Several of the buildings are Grade II listed. It takes its name from Philip Stanhope, the 4th Earl of Chesterfield, a politician, diplomat and writer. Another resident, Admiral of the Fleet Sir George Rodney Mundy, died here. He was a Royal Navy officer who persuaded the Dutch to surrender Antwerp during the Belgian Revolution, and who later served on the East Indies Station, where he took the Sultan of Brunei's son-in-law to witness the island of Labuan become British.
